home.title: A sticker on every Lidl shrimp box
home.why_body: Shrimp sold at Lidl are left to suffocate in ice, fully conscious. In Great Britain, Lidl has promised to change this. Everywhere else, it hasn't.
home.step1: Download the sticker and print it.
home.step2: Stick it on a shrimp box at Lidl.
home.step3: Log it here. Your stickers show up on the map.

stickers.title: Get stickers
stickers.body: Pick a language, download, print at 10 × 10 cm. Sticker paper works best.
stickers.where: Only on shrimp boxes at Lidl.

about.title: How we count
about.intro: Each sticker helps about {per} shrimp a year, in expectation. Here is the math.
about.formula: Shrimp helped per sticker = S × p ÷ N
about.s: S = {s}: shrimp a year a Lidl commitment would cover.
about.s_note: Lidl and Kaufland sell about 2.2 billion shrimp a year. We count half, the own-brand warm-water shrimp such policies cover, minus about 71 million already covered by Lidl in Great Britain.
about.p: p = {p}: the share of the win owed to store actions like stickers. A guess.
about.n: N = {n}: stickers needed to win. A guess.
about.same_logic: It's the same method the Aldi campaign used, which gave 34 shrimp per action.
about.source_europe: Rethink Priorities: the number of shrimp in major European markets (2026)
about.source_germany: Rethink Priorities: shrimp in the German retail market (2026)
about.credits: Store locations © OpenStreetMap contributors. Map by OpenFreeMap, © OpenMapTiles.

privacy.title: Privacy and imprint
privacy.stored_1: An anonymous ID for this browser. No email, no phone number, no name.
privacy.stored_3: Your entries: store, number of stickers, date.
privacy.stored_4: Nicknames people report, and who reported them.
privacy.not_1: No cookies, no tracking, no ads, no analytics.
privacy.not_2: Your location is only used to find nearby stores. It's rounded to about 1 km and not saved.
privacy.public_1: Your nickname and sticker total on the leaderboard, and each store's total on the map. Never who stuck what, where or when.
privacy.services_title: Services that see your IP address
privacy.services_1: GitHub Pages, which hosts the site.
privacy.services_2: Supabase, the database, on servers in Frankfurt.
privacy.services_3: Cloudflare Turnstile, the robot check, only when you log stickers.
privacy.services_4: OpenFreeMap, the map tiles, only on the map page.
privacy.rights_1: You can delete everything at any time under My stickers. For anything else, write to {email}.
